nodes.long_description:
MuralView2 is a mixed reality visualization tool built for mural artists, designers, and clients. Import your artwork and place it directly onto real-world walls through Meta Quest, giving you a true sense of scale, placement, and composition before the first drop of paint hits the wall.

Move, scale, rotate, mirror, and adjust your artwork while standing in the actual space. Fine-tune opacity and positioning to visualize how a mural will interact with architectural features and the surrounding environment.

Shared Vision takes mural planning further by allowing multiple Meta Quest headsets to view the same mural placement together in the same physical space. Artists, assistants, and clients can walk around the project and experience the proposed mural from different viewpoints at the same time.

Whether you’re planning a large commercial mural, presenting a concept to a client, or working out placement before painting, MuralView2 helps bridge the gap between a digital design and the finished wall.

Plan it. Place it. See it before you paint it.
nodes.short_description:
Use this for the Short Description:

Visualize your mural before you paint it. MuralView2 lets artists import artwork and place it directly on real-world walls in mixed reality. Scale, position, rotate, adjust opacity, and preview designs at true scale using Meta Quest. Shared Vision lets multiple headsets view the same mural placement together, making it easier to plan, present, and collaborate with clients.

nodes.change_log:
WHAT’S NEW

PLACEMENT Lock puts the print on a wall pin, not on the headset. Take the headset off, look somewhere else, and put it back on — the picture stays on the wall, not in front of your face. LOCK PLACEMENT works again after unlock. Previous and overnight return use that same pin.

START After the splash, the welcome card sits in the room about 4 feet in front of you and stays there when you turn your head. START puts the control panel in that same spot, not two feet from your face.

SHARED VISION Leave a session and the picture comes off the wall into Shared Vision. Tap it and make a VECTOR copy if it is an SVG. Host and join during the session are unchanged.

TRANSFORM Open TRANSFORM or DISTORT and the window starts with ATTENTION: only JPEG and PNG can be transformed for now, not SVG.

LAYERS LAYERS in LIBRARY uses the same window and the same actions as LAYERS in TRANSFORM — swipe, lock, duplicate, delete, move, and scroll.

Controllers only. English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.

SVG files now work like the other pictures, except fold, curve, and warp — that is the next build. Website uploads can be JPEG, PNG, or SVG, each tile shows a type badge, and tapping an SVG opens it as a vector with full color, the same shape as the file, and layers you can scroll. Place it on the wall the same way as a photo: grab it, size it, fade it, lock or unlock placement, and Previous brings it back on that wall at the size and fade you left. After you lock it you can host Shared Vision; the other Quest joins and receives the SVG at the same pose, size, and fade, and hosted or joined SVGs sit on the Shared Vision shelf. The whole drawing fades together now, so dark overlapping parts no longer linger while other plates go first. If the control panel is between you and the print, the titles and window words stay in front; if the print is between you and the panel, the print covers the panel.

What’s new

MuralView2 / Shared Vision now opens with a short how-to, then the board. Double-tap LIBRARY to open or close the control panel. Press A and B together, or X and Y, to bring the board about four feet in front of you if you left it on the floor. Pick a picture from headset photos or muralview2.com. Library tiles match the website window. A picture in use goes faint — tap it to take it down. The little X only deletes it from the library. A locked picture asks New placement or Previous placement. Previous puts it back on that wall, same size, shape, and fade. PLACE still shoots the print onto the real wall, floor, or ceiling. DRAW moves, enlarges, flips, and spins. Push the stick to slide; click the stick down to go five times as fast. Hold the trigger and push up or down to fade, or left or right to spin. TRANSFORM folds, curves, and warps, with grabable handles and a frame that stays on the paper. Undo All lays the flaps back, leaves your fold lines, and does not keep leftover lag for the next fold. Shared Vision lets another Quest in the same room see the print where you locked it — host after you lock placement; they tap JOIN SESSION on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot. Controllers only. English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.
